author: bardic-inspiration
name: Throne of Elements
summary: Raises a throne of elemental power that grants command of the surrounding land.

stats.effect: A throne of fire, ice, stone, and storm rises within range, and you sit on it. Each turn you choose one elemental effect: a 60-foot-radius Sphere of fire (15d8 Fire damage), frost, earth, or storm, centered within 120 feet. Creatures in the area make a Dexterity saving throw, taking half as much damage on a success.
